notes.title: Small update! Mod support and fixes 👻
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Hello SpöökTubers and welcome to a small update! In this patch, we have some fixes but most importantly we have added mod support via the Steam Workshop![/b][/h3]

[h3]Patch Notes: [/h3]

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Controller support (rebindable using SteamInput)
[*] Steam Workshop support for mods
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] A bunch of defibrillator fixes, for example not being able to speak after being rezzed
[*] Fixes related to the extraction failing when you try to get your video
[*] Expanded shadow settings allow for higher-quality shadows
[*] Made tooltips correctly display rebindable keys
[*] Made select items 1-3 rebindable
[*] Matchmaking now prioritises lower ping matches
[/list]

[h3]Why mod support?[/h3]
When we launched CW there were immediately a bunch of really cool mods being made, so we're super happy to make it possible for those mods to be on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2881650/workshop/]Steam workshop[/url]! 

The CW team is small and doesn’t have enough capacity for continuous updates alongside their other work, so having mod support is a great way to empower the community to create cool new stuff! We had hoped to have this up and running earlier but it took a little longer than expected. 

If you are a modder, here is the current documentation for creating and uploading mods: [url=https://github.com/landfallgames/ExampleCWPlugin]https://github.com/landfallgames/ExampleCWPlugin[/url]

There’s also an unofficial [url=https://discord.com/invite/yeGDSm4gFq]modding Discord [/url]you can join to find out more about Content Warning mods.

We can’t wait to see what kind of mods you all create!

[h3]Re the video extraction issues:[/h3]
In the last couple of patches we, with your help, solved several issues that led to videos failing to extract. We want to thank everyone who sent in logs and other information to help us fix as many of these bugs as possible. 

There are sadly a million things that can lead to extraction issues for the videos, some of which we have no control over on our end (like one team-mate having a weird file structure on their computer) but we have done our best to fix the most common ones. If you are still having issues after this update please reach out to our support at support@landfall.se so we can help troubleshoot. 

[h3]Future updates:[/h3]
As we spoke about in our last [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2881650/view/4370264726190091136?l=english]patch[/url], the dev-team is made up of five developers who took some time off from their main project to work on Content Warning. 

The other [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1796470/HASTE_Broken_Worlds/]project [/url]has been in the works since 2021 together with a bigger team, so it’s important to the devs that they come back to finish it. As we explained in our latest post, they won’t work more on CW during this time. Therefore, we don’t know when or if there will be more Content Warning updates. 

That said we’re very happy with what Content Warning has become! It’s been a wild ride for a six-week project that blew all of our expectations out of the water. We’re thankful to you all who have been on this journey down to the old world with us so far, and we can’t wait to see what mod support brings!

[h3]Finding games:[/h3]
If you’re having issues finding other players, we recommend checking out our Discord where you can find others to play with [url=https://discord.gg/contentwarning]https://discord.gg/contentwarning[/url]

[h3]Ports:[/h3]
We’re working with a porting studio to get the game onto other platforms, so we hope to have more news about that next year. Porting also means we will add achievements for PC!

[h3]Support:[/h3]
You can find help in our [url=https://landfall.se/content-warning-faq ]Content Warning FAQ [/url]for the most common issues if you still need help you can also reach out to support@landfall.se for help troubleshooting or to ask questions about the game.

notes.title: Patch: Language match-making, a new item and fixes!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone! Here’s a new patch adding language matchmaking for those of you who want to play in your native language, a new purchasable item, infinite loading fixes and more solutions to the video extraction problems.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957545/c8bb5aca81f53c735c2830d139baa33e9b85230b.png[/img]

[h3]Patch Notes: [/h3]

[b]Added: [/b]
[list]
🛠️ Added a new purchasable item, "Sketch Pad" 
🛠️ Added new matchmaking options for spoken languages 
🛠️ Additional LODs for slightly better GPU performance on older GPUs
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
🪲 Fixed issues with infinite loading
🪲 Fixed additional issues with video extraction failing (please send us logs when this happens)
🪲 Fixed issue with "hold the bomb" contract not being able to be fulfilled
[/list]

[b]This will be the last patch for a while since ThePetHen, Skog, Zorro, Wilnyl and Philip have prior commitments to another project that they have been working on with another team since 2021. In the meantime, we are looking into getting the game onto other platforms! We hope to have more news about that and the future of Content Warning before the end of the year.

We also want to shout out the amazing modders working on fun mods and improvements for the game. You can find more information about modding on the unofficial modding discord here: [url=https://discord.gg/vEG7FZGsdk]https://discord.gg/vEG7FZGsdk[/url][/b]

notes.title: Content Warning Small Patch fixing various issues
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone! The devs are back from a short break and working on bug fixes, thank you all for reporting issues and sending us detailed information and logs - if you experience more issues after this update please send us new logs and reports to support@landfall.se so we can take a look![/h3]

[h2]Patch Notes: [/h2]
[list]
🪲 Fixed issue where recording player's voice would be too low
🪲Localization Fixes
🪲 Fixed some issues with video extraction failing - we are still looking into this
🛠️ Added more logging to help us figure out the video extraction issue
[/list]

[b]Please send us your logs if video extraction fails with the new update! This will help us figure out why it is happening so we can fix it![/b]

The player log contains information on your latest game session which can help us track down bugs. Recreate the bug you’re experiencing in the game before getting the log here:

[olist]
[*] Press and hold the Windows key and the letter R on your keyboard 
[*] Type appdata into the prompt that appears 
[*] Then navigate to LocalLow\Landfall Games\Content Warning> locate the file called “Player” and send it to support@landfall.se
[/olist]
  
[b]We know a lot of you are wondering about content updates, we're currently focusing on fixes and quality-of-life features. As we've spoken about in the past we don't do estimates for updates as it leads to crunch for the team but we will let you know when and if a new update is on the way! :)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957545/1046dc05685564812cfde19bbb11b3f9e74f0570.gif[/img]

notes.title: New update! New map, monsters, items, sponsorships and meta progression 👻
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone, here's the first big update to Content Warning! We've added a bunch of new stuff like a new map, monsters, items, meta progression etc. We've also fixed some of the bugs and put in more logging to see if we can fix the rest. [/h3]


[h3][b]Patch notes:[/b][/h3]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
🎉 Added a new map
🎉 Added 13 new monsters
🎉 Added new item, Rescue hook
🎉 Added a hat shop
🎉 Added unlockable sky island upgrades
🎉 Added sponsored video deals that can be picked after the first week
🎉 Added MetaCoins for purchasing island upgrades and hats
🎉 Added a new rare cursed item in the old world
🎉 Added a mirror in the house[/list]
[b]Changes/improvements:[/b]
[list]
🛠️ Changed level selection to random
🛠️ General Monster Balancing
🛠️ Various audio improvements
🛠️ Slightly boosted player voice range
🛠️ Reworked modding matchmaking
🛠️Optimized video network performance to get faster extractions in some cases[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b][list]
🪲Fixed VSync not working after using the dive bell.
🪲Fixed some sound issues including the sound echoing too much
🪲Fixed issue where players would fall through the map when sleeping on the ceiling
🪲Fixed issue where the camera would sometimes not go into the video extraction machine
🪲Fixed issue where the game would end when you surface with only the broken camera 
🪲Fixed issue where the boom mic would extend your body’s hit-box
🪲Fixed issue where the shock stick would only work once on monsters or team-mates
🪲Fixed issue where holding an item when going up or down with the diving bell would cause issues picking up other items
🪲Fixed issue where holding an exploding bomb would delete the player holding it
🪲Fixed issue when the last player alive left you would not return to the surface
🪲Possible fix for the dive bell door bug
🪲Possible fix for the audio popping issue
🪲Possible fix for defibrillator speed bug[/list]


We’re still looking into the other bugs reported with the Extraction bug being one of our priorities, with this update we’ve added logs to see if we can figure out what goes wrong. If the Extraction Failure bug happens to you please send us your logs (Found in: Appdata/Local Low/LandfallGames/Content Warning/player.log and player-prev.log while the game is still running) to support@landfall.se so that we can have a look, your logs may be the key to fixing it. 

If you’re having issues please check out our FAQ [url=landfall.se/content-warning-faq]landfall.se/content-warning-faq[/url] for some common fixes.     


[h3]Enjoy![/h3]

PS our friends over at HappyHead Games just released their new game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1732420/Spanky/]Spanky![/url] if you like physics multiplayer games you should check it out.
